title: W11800233 — Automatic Test Mode
description: Service Diagnostic Key 2 + START runs valves, drain, wash, and spin sequence (lid closed).

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 4.0–4.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (WTW4100 ACU)

steps.title: Enter Automatic Test Mode
steps.body: With Service Diagnostic active, press Key 2 then press START (lid must be closed). Sequence: water valves (fill to 70 mm) → drain pump (to 3 mm) → wash (shifter agitate) → spin (140/300/500 rpm). Key 1 repeats previous step; Key 2 skips to next. POWER exits to standby.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Key 2 used to activate Service Diagnostic Mode. To start Automatic Test Mode, press Key 5/Start.
